name: pantry
description: A capability-scoped recipe store on Cloudflare Workers + D1. It stores and hands back scripts; it never runs them.

scripts.dev:public: bun run build:public && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:ops: bun run build:ops && wrangler dev --config wrangler.ax.jsonc --env-file .dev.vars.ops
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run check:svelte && bunx --bun @biomejs/biome check . && bun run test
scripts.deploy:public: bun run build:public && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:ops: bun run build:ops && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.ax.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:public:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply pantry-db --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:ops:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply pantry-db --remote --config wrangler.ax.jsonc

author: Jordan Coeyman (https://coey.dev)
